notes:
sl s2 (typed on my phone sorry)

drowned chapel under the reef
- buck read rest of logbook (learned the script lol) - salt mother = sea hag, keeper traded the light for his drowned daughter
- doro champ devotion crit? no just success, +1 next save. hit the chest w/ hammer, bounced
- pim peeked in chest untrained arcana CF, brine to face. then yeeted the chest onto the altar right to the hag 🤦
- ione talked thru the chest (dip succ) - its MARIS the daughter trapped inside as seawater kid. glafka light scout nothing
- buck jumped for altar fail, then ARM WRESTLED the hag's hand coming out of the water & lost by 1 (23 v 24) got dragged under 😭
- kestrel shot the altar 8 dmg, hag shows up + 2 drowned sailors

fight
- r1 doro nat1 smashed a pew. hag nat1 on doro too lmao
- pim improvised blinding w/ salt SUCC, hag blinded. swam to buck
- buck underwater: water ballet trip nat1, kick miss, wall run fail. fort save succ held breath
- kestrel salt-wind shot hit 7, 2nd miss
- ione begged hag to let maris go CF, cantrip missed, sailor hit her 10
- r2 doro crit the chest lock 27 🔓 buck failed to yank chest but NAT20 ripped the lid off!!
- ione fire on hag 13, shoved the sailor off her
- pim tried to tow ione to shore nat1 both sank
- kestrel shot at chest miss
- maris out, back to a girl by dawn. hag let go + melted into the tide (got away)

week in brinemouth
- doro shield drills fail, helped at fish market (dip succ), scholar lore on salt mother (arc succ), arm wrestling NAT 20 champion of the tavern 🏆
- pim dried his stuff nat1 = thieves tools ruined, tried to steal shiny fish scales fail, arm wrestling fail
- ione texts w/ scholar succ, lighthouse inscriptions fail, "θα μάθω να παλεύω με το χέρι" learned arm wrestling... fail
- buck arm wrestling AGAIN fail (3 sessions straight), taught maris a cartwheel succ ❤️, diving contest vs fisherman fail
- kestrel archery fail, gozreh temple lore succ, WON the arm wrestling tournament
- town pays half the new lens we owe the rest

next: the hag got away. bring hero points. does blinded stack w/ off-guard? ask doro lol
